title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing): Courtesy Starting Amount by Size of the Corrected Error
content:
The corrected error on a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account owed a service-recovery courtesy is the total of the account's uninsured discount adjustments (on such an account every one of them is self-pay pricing posted late).

**Clause.** A corrected error of at least 5000.00 USD sets the courtesy's starting amount to 0.005 of the corrected error (one half of one percent), rounded half-up to the cent; a corrected error of at least 500.00 but below 5000.00 sets it to a flat 25.00; a smaller corrected error leaves the starting amount at the standard courtesy.

| Corrected error | Starting amount |
|---|---|
| at least 5000.00 | 0.005 of the corrected error, rounded half-up to the cent |
| at least 500.00, below 5000.00 | 25.00 flat |
| below 500.00 | the standard courtesy |

## Worked figures (hypothetical totals)

- Uninsured discount adjustments of 4200.00 and 1800.00 total 6000.00: starting amount 30.00.
- 5000.00: 25.00, from 0.005 of 5000.00; 4999.99: 25.00 flat.
- 500.00: 25.00 flat; 499.99: the standard courtesy.
- 8338.00: 0.005 of it is 41.69.
